### Run interactive web search setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/moonshot.md

Starts the interactive setup CLI to configure Kimi web search under the web section.

```bash
openclaw configure --section web
```

--------------------------------

### Install Docker and Docker Compose

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/hetzner.md

Installs prerequisites and Docker engine using the official setup script, then prints installed versions.

```bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
docker --version
docker compose version
```

--------------------------------

### Run OpenClaw setup assistant with openclaw setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/web/tui.md

Start the setup and repair assistant interactively or execute one-off requests using -m. Pass --yes to apply persistent configuration writes without interactive approval prompts.

```bash
openclaw setup                       # start interactively
openclaw setup -m "status"           # run one request and exit
openclaw setup -m "set default model openai/gpt-5.2" --yes   # apply a config write
```

--------------------------------

### Define Thread Start Params

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Specifies initialization parameters including model, feature flags, dynamic tools, workspace cwd, and approval policies when starting a thread.

```json
{
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "config": {
    "features.apply_patch_streaming_events": true,
    "features.code_mode": {
      "direct_only_tool_namespaces": ["openclaw_direct"],
      "enabled": true
    },
    "features.code_mode_only": false,
    "features.goals": false,
    "features.shell_tool": true,
    "features.standalone_web_search": false,
    "project_doc_max_bytes": 131072,
    "suppress_unstable_features_warning": true,
    "tools.update_plan.enabled": false,
    "web_search": "cached"
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "developerInstructions": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
  "dynamicTools": [
    "agents_list",
    "message",
    "sessions_spawn",
    "automations",
    "gateway",
    "nodes",
    "session_status",
    "sessions_history",
    "sessions_list",
    "sessions_search",
    "sessions_send",
    "subagents",
    "tts",
    "web_fetch",
    "web_search",
    "sessions_yield"
  ],
  "experimentalRawEvents": true,
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandbox": "danger-full-access",
  "serviceName": "OpenClaw"
}
```

### Turn start parameter configuration for Telegram direct message tool

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/test/fixtures/agents/prompt-snapshots/codex-runtime-happy-path/telegram-direct-codex-message-tool.md

Defines runtime parameters including untrusted sender data, delivery policies, model settings, and sandbox access for the turn execution.

```json
{
  "additionalContext": {
    "openclaw_current_sender": {
      "kind": "untrusted",
      "value": "{\"sender\":{\"id\":\"1000001\",\"name\":\"Pash\",\"username\":\"pash\"}}"
    },
    "openclaw_source_delivery": {
      "kind": "application",
      "value": "Current source-delivery policy for this turn (replaces earlier source-delivery guidance):\nVisible source replies are not automatically delivered for this run. Use `message(action=send)` for user-visible source-channel output. For progress, set `final=false`. Set `final=true`, or omit it, for the completed reply to the current source conversation; OpenClaw stops after confirming delivery. Do not repeat visible message content in your final answer.\n\n`send`: `message`; current source is default target. Set `target` only elsewhere."
    },
    "openclaw_temporal_context": {
      "kind": "application",
      "value": "## Temporal Context\nCurrent date: 2026-01-01\nTime zone: UTC\nFor the exact current time, use `session_status`."
    }
  },
  "approvalPolicy": "never",
  "approvalsReviewer": "user",
  "collaborationMode": {
    "mode": "default",
    "settings": {
      "developer_instructions": null,
      "model": "gpt-5.5",
      "reasoning_effort": "medium"
    }
  },
  "cwd": "/tmp/openclaw-happy-path/workspace",
  "effort": "medium",
  "input": [
    {
      "text": "<see Reconstructed Model-Bound Prompt Layers>",
      "text_elements": [],
      "type": "text"
    }
  ],
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "personality": "none",
  "sandboxPolicy": {
    "type": "dangerFullAccess"
  },
  "threadId": "thread-telegram-direct-codex-message-tool"
}
```

### Run Feishu channel setup wizard

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/feishu.md

Installs the @openclaw/feishu plugin if missing and guides through manual or QR code setup for Feishu or Lark.

```bash
openclaw channels login --channel feishu
```

### Run interactive configuration wizards

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/gateway/configuration.md

Start the full onboarding flow or run the guided configuration wizard from the command line.

```bash
openclaw onboard       # full onboarding flow
openclaw configure     # config wizard
```

--------------------------------

### Run guided onboarding setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/clickclack.md

Launches the interactive onboarding flow to configure server URL, bot token, and workspace settings. A failed post-save verification check does not discard saved configuration.

```bash
openclaw onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Start Buzz channel guided setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/buzz.md

Launches the interactive setup wizard to configure a Buzz relay, account, and bot identity. Setup validates room access and persists configuration for Gateway operation.

```bash
openclaw channels add --channel buzz
```

--------------------------------

### Start development Gateway in watch mode

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/start/setup.md

Installs dependencies, performs initial setup, and launches the Gateway watch process in a managed tmux session with hot reloading.

```bash
pnpm install
# First run only (or after resetting local OpenClaw config/workspace)
pnpm openclaw setup
pnpm gateway:watch
```

--------------------------------

### Run one-time or rotation signing setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/ios/fastlane/SETUP.md

Plans, checks, and creates Developer Portal bundle IDs and required services before running match.

```bash
pnpm ios:release:signing:plan
pnpm ios:release:signing:check
pnpm ios:release:signing:setup
```

### Launch guided interactive setup for a specific channel

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/channels.md

Starts interactive channel configuration for Telegram using either positional channel selection or the `--channel` flag.

```bash
openclaw channels add telegram
openclaw channels add --channel telegram
```

### Run onboarding setup in the container

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/podman.md

Launches the container in setup mode for initial onboarding. Access the UI at http://127.0.0.1:18789/ with the token generated in ~/.openclaw/.env.

```bash
./scripts/run-openclaw-podman.sh launch setup
```

### Get Teams app install link with teams app get

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/channels/msteams.md

Retrieves the direct install link for your registered Teams app using its Teams App ID.

```bash
teams app get <teamsAppId> --install-link
```

### Install OpenClaw with automated install script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/help/faq-first-run.md

Runs the automated installation script and immediately launches the guided onboarding flow.

```bash
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Install and start OpenClaw Gateway via quick path

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/platforms/chromeos.md

Installs a supported Node runtime and OpenClaw, sets up the daemon service, and verifies Gateway status inside the Crostini Terminal.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash
```

```bash
openclaw onboard --install-daemon
```

```bash
openclaw gateway status
```

--------------------------------

### Run Docker setup script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/docker-vm-runtime.md

Initializes host directories, builds the local image, runs onboarding, generates a Gateway token, synchronizes configuration, and starts the container via Docker Compose.

```bash
./scripts/docker/setup.sh
```

### Quick Start Commands for sag

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/skills/sag/SKILL.md

Basic commands to get started with `sag` for text-to-speech, including simple synthesis, specifying a voice, listing available voices, and getting model-specific tips.

```bash
sag "Hello there"
```

```bash
sag speak -v "Roger" "Hello"
```

```bash
sag voices
```

```bash
sag prompting
```

### Run onboarding wizard with daemon installation

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/README.md

Start onboarding manually if the package was installed directly via npm, pnpm, or Bun. Verifies model access, sets up the workspace, and configures the Gateway.

```bash
openclaw onboard --install-daemon
```

### Install OpenClaw skipping onboarding

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/install/installer.md

Executes the installer with the `--no-onboard` flag to bypass the onboarding setup.

```bash
curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash -s -- --no-onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Build and onboard OpenClaw from source

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/help/faq-first-run.md

Clones the repository, installs dependencies with pnpm, builds core and UI packages, and launches the onboarding wizard.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git
cd openclaw
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm ui:build
openclaw onboard
```

--------------------------------

### Install Bundler dependencies for reproducible setup

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/android/fastlane/SETUP.md

Installs Bundler 2.6.9 and locked dependencies from apps/android/Gemfile.lock for a checksum-locked environment.

```bash
cd apps/android
gem install bundler -v 2.6.9
bundle _2.6.9_ install
```

### Onboard Alibaba Model Studio via interactive CLI

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/providers/alibaba.md

Starts the onboarding flow to configure the API key for the Alibaba provider interactively.

```bash
openclaw onboard --auth-choice alibaba-model-studio-api-key
```

--------------------------------

### Install Gateway with a custom wrapper script

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/cli/gateway.md

Creates an executable wrapper script and installs the Gateway service using the `--wrapper` option before restarting the service.

```bash
cat > ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec doppler run --project my-project --config production -- openclaw "$@"
EOF
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler

openclaw gateway install --wrapper ~/.local/bin/openclaw-doppler --force
openclaw gateway restart
```

--------------------------------

### Example configuration for installed marketplace plugin

Source: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/plugins/codex-native-plugins.md

Demonstrates the codexPlugins configuration entry generated upon installing a marketplace-qualified plugin.

```json5
{
  plugins: {
    entries: {
      codex: {
        enabled: true,
        config: {
          codexPlugins: {
            enabled: true,
            plugins: {
              "security-review@company-tools": {
                enabled: true,
                marketplaceName: "company-tools",
                pluginName: "security-review",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}
```
